title: Michael’s Last Dundies
one_paragraph_synopsis: In "Michael’s Last Dundies," Michael Scott prepares for his final Dundie Awards by personally delivering nomination certificates with DeAngelo, who struggles with hosting duties. The episode features humorous and awkward moments during the awards ceremony, including Erin's public breakup with Gabe and DeAngelo's rambling acceptance speech. Despite some conflicts and challenges, Michael reflects on the significance of the Dundies and is encouraged by his coworkers to continue the tradition.

main_threads.thread: Michael and DeAngelo prepare for and host the Dundie Awards, with DeAngelo struggling to perform as host and Michael reflecting on his last Dundies.

evidence.snippet: Michael: It is six a.m. and we are about to go house to house to give everyone their Dundie Nomination Certificates.
Michael: Think of it as part of your training.
Deangelo: This is so weird! If I'm conducting a meeting, good to go. But if I think of it as a performance… I-I fall apart.
Michael: There are a lot of great salesmen in this office, but one of our great salesmen is also a great dad. And a close personal friend of mine, Jim Halpert! Best Dad Dundie!
Deangelo: Hold on, hold on one second. I WANNA, I WANNA, I FEEL TRULY BLESSED! UHHH, TO BE WORKING WITH ALL OF YOU!
Michael (Outside of the restaurant, obviously sad): So that is how it ends. My last Dundies ever.

main_threads.thread: Erin deals with her relationship issues with Gabe, culminating in a public breakup during the Dundies ceremony.

evidence.snippet: Erin: I eat lunch in the car now. It's my alone time. It's just nice to have some time away from Gabe.

Erin: I can't just dump him Pam, I'm not like you, I can't be mean.

Gabe: What?
Erin: I'm not attracted to you. I just, I cringe when you talk.
